route2_two_sided_search.argument: with M' = L M R and L, R diagonal monomial factors, left multiplication scales a whole row by one monomial, so it can remove exactly the stages common to every monomial of that row; right multiplication scales a column, is injective within a column, and entries in different columns sit in different matrix positions, so no cancellation is possible.  A two-sided monomial conjugation can therefore only shrink a row by its common factor and can otherwise only widen it
route2_two_sided_search.consequence: Route 2 cannot be closed by any monomial conjugation of the controller operator.  The only remaining positive route is a genuinely different controller/operator whose thinned rows are the design frames natively
